segments.time: Day, soft daylight through the floor-to-ceiling windows
segments.first_state: Ji Ran stands behind the walnut executive desk, which is centred in front of the floor-to-ceiling windows. She faces the front pin-up wall, with the high-backed black leather chair behind her. She wears the fitted dove-grey silk shirt and the black bodycon pencil skirt. She holds the black gooseneck kettle over the glass V60 dripper, which sits on its glass server at the pour-over station on the desk. The white coffee cup sits on its saucer beside the station. The desktop also holds spread architectural plans, a fan of wood samples and the small brushed-metal figurine. Camera side: in front of the desk, on the pin-up wall side, facing the desk and the windows.

shots.camera: Wide shot, fast push in, eye level, from the pin-up wall facing the desk and the windows
shots.visual: The sleek office with the city skyline behind the glass. Ji Ran stands behind the walnut desk among the plans and wood samples, pouring a thin stream from the black kettle into the dripper. Her lips stay closed.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Su Yaqing, V.O., in Chinese, teasing and sing-song): {听说你爸想让你跟路少泽联姻，} <Water trickles through the paper filter>

shots.camera: Close-up insert, locked-off camera, high angle, from the front of the desk looking down at the pour-over station
shots.visual: Ji Ran's hand circles the gooseneck kettle, and the water spirals over the coffee grounds in the glass dripper.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Su Yaqing, V.O., in Chinese, gossipy): {你当年那么爱他，}

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the front of the desk
shots.visual: Ji Ran sets the kettle down and braces one hand flat on the desk beside the plans. Her mouth stays closed and her expression turns cold.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Su Yaqing, V.O., in Chinese, drawn out and mocking): {怎么样是不是很开心啊？}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, slight push in, low angle, from the front of the desk
shots.visual: Ji Ran lifts her eyes toward the pin-up wall with a flat, icy half-smile, her hand still braced on the desk.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, in Chinese, deadpan and cold): {开心，他死了我更开心。}

segments.light_audio: Soft daylight from the windows behind the desk, warm recessed ceiling spots and the black task lamp on the desk. Quiet office hum and the trickle of coffee.

dialogue.speaker: su_yaqing
dialogue.line: 听说你爸想让你跟路少泽联姻，你当年那么爱他，怎么样是不是很开心啊？

must_hit: Ji Ran pours water through the coffee filter at her desk
Ji Ran braces a hand on the desk with a cold expression
segments.exit_state: Ji Ran stands behind the walnut executive desk in front of the floor-to-ceiling windows. One hand is braced on the desktop, and she faces the pin-up wall with a cold expression. The kettle rests beside the dripper and server at the pour-over station, and the white cup is on its saucer.

segments.scene_heading: INT. JI FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY #1-2#
segments.first_state: Ji Hongyuan sits on the long cream leather sofa in front of the French windows, facing the front display cabinets. The low marble-and-gilt coffee table stands in front of him on the beige patterned carpet, and the kraft document envelope lies on it. Lu Shaoze, at 23, stands on the carpet on the near side of the coffee table, facing the sofa with his head bowed. He wears the fitted navy-blue knit polo sweater, the charcoal-grey wool trousers and black derby shoes. The younger Ji Ran, at 22, stands half-hidden behind the white marble column, which is in front of the left wall near the archway. She wears the black knit mini dress, her long hair straight, and peers around the column. Camera side: in front of everyone, on the display-cabinet side, facing the sofa and the windows.

shots.camera: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the display cabinets facing the French windows
shots.visual: Leaves sway outside the sunlit French windows. Ji Hongyuan, on the cream sofa, sweeps the document envelope off the marble table with the back of his hand. It drops onto the carpet at the feet of Lu Shaoze, who keeps his head bowed. Ji Ran peers from behind the marble column by the archway.
shots.audio: <A thick envelope thuds onto the carpet>

shots.camera: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot from behind Lu Shaoze on the display-cabinet side, eye level, facing the sofa
shots.visual: Ji Hongyuan leans back on the cream sofa with his arms spread and looks at Lu Shaoze with contempt. Lu Shaoze's shoulder and the back of his head fill the foreground.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Hongyuan, in Chinese, slow and final): {我已经给纪然安排好了联姻对象，是陈氏集团的公子，}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single, locked-off camera, low angle, from the coffee table side facing Lu Shaoze
shots.visual: Only Lu Shaoze, framed on the face and shoulders. He keeps his head down, swallows hard and clenches his jaw.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Hongyuan, in Chinese, cold): {也给你安排了国外的学校，}

shots.camera: Close-up, fast push in, eye level, from the display-cabinet side facing the sofa
shots.visual: Ji Hongyuan's narrow eyes stay hard behind his gold-rimmed glasses.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Hongyuan, in Chinese, a flat command): {以后，不要再来找纪然。}

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the display-cabinet side
shots.visual: Ji Hongyuan snorts and turns his face away toward the fireplace.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Hongyuan, in Chinese, a dismissive grunt): {嗯。}

shots.camera: Medium shot, follow Lu Shaoze from the coffee table to the archway, eye level, from the display-cabinet side
shots.visual: Lu Shaoze stoops, picks up the envelope from the carpet and walks toward the archway by the left wall. He passes the marble column without noticing Ji Ran, who stays hidden behind it with her fists clenched.
shots.audio: <Paper crinkles, footsteps on marble>

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single, handheld, high angle, from the room's centre facing the left wall
shots.visual: Lu Shaoze is gone through the archway. Ji Ran slumps back against the left wall beside the column, a hand on her chest, gasping for breath with wet eyes.
shots.audio: <Ragged breathing>

segments.light_audio: Warm afternoon sunlight through the French windows from the back and slightly from the left, and the crystal chandelier. Rustling leaves, quiet villa air, footsteps.

dialogue.speaker: ji_hongyuan
dialogue.line: 我已经给纪然安排好了联姻对象，是陈氏集团的公子，也给你安排了国外的学校，以后，不要再来找纪然。

must_hit: Ji Hongyuan pushes the envelope off the table onto the carpet
Lu Shaoze picks up the envelope and walks past Ji Ran without seeing her
Ji Ran slumps against the wall struggling to breathe
segments.exit_state: Ji Hongyuan sits on the cream leather sofa in front of the French windows, his face turned away toward the fireplace. Lu Shaoze has left through the archway by the left wall with the envelope. Ji Ran leans slumped against the left wall beside the marble column, a hand on her chest, breathing hard.
negative: spatial jumps of the marble column and archway

segments.time: Day, soft daylight through the floor-to-ceiling windows
segments.first_state: Ji Ran stands behind the walnut executive desk in front of the floor-to-ceiling windows, facing the pin-up wall. She wears the dove-grey silk shirt and the black pencil skirt. The white coffee cup, now filled, sits on its saucer at the pour-over station beside the kettle, dripper and server. The plans, wood samples and metal figurine lie across the desktop, and the black leather chair stands behind her. Camera side: in front of the desk, on the pin-up wall side, facing the desk and the windows.

shots.camera: Medium close-up, slow push in, eye level, from the front of the desk
shots.visual: Ji Ran lifts the white cup and sips, her eyes distant and her lips on the rim.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, low and bitter): {五年前，纪宏远逼走路少泽，让我跟陈家联姻。}

shots.camera: Close-up insert, locked-off camera, high angle, over the pour-over station
shots.visual: Ji Ran's hand sets the cup back down firmly on its saucer.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, cool): {现在路少泽发达了，} <Porcelain clicks>

shots.camera: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the pin-up wall facing the desk and the windows
shots.visual: Ji Ran turns from the desk toward the floor-to-ceiling windows and the city skyline, her mouth closed.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, scornful): {又迫不及待悔婚，把我塞给路少泽。}

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, low angle, from the front of the desk
shots.visual: Ji Ran turns back toward the pin-up wall and plants both hands on the desk beside the plans.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, hard): {在他眼里，我永远都只是}

shots.camera: Close-up, slow push in on her eyes, eye level, from the front of the desk
shots.visual: Ji Ran's gaze hardens into steely resolve, her lips pressed shut.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, icy): {一个待价而沽的工具。}

segments.light_audio: Daylight from the windows behind the desk, warm ceiling spots and the desk task lamp. Faint city hum through the glass.

dialogue.speaker: ji_ran
dialogue.line: 五年前，纪宏远逼走路少泽，让我跟陈家联姻。现在路少泽发达了，又迫不及待悔婚，把我塞给路少泽。在他眼里，我永远都只是一个待价而沽的工具。

must_hit: Ji Ran sips her coffee and sets the cup down
Ji Ran's gaze hardens in close-up
segments.exit_state: Ji Ran stands behind the walnut executive desk, both hands planted on it, facing the pin-up wall with a hard gaze. The cup rests on its saucer at the pour-over station.

segments.scene_heading: INT. SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM - DAY #1-4#
segments.time: Day, soft daylight through sheer curtains
segments.first_state: Su Yaqing lounges on the cream bouclé sofa in the middle of the room. The sofa's back is to the curtained windows and it faces the TV wall. She wears the lilac camisole and the white mini skirt, barefoot, and holds the phone up in one hand on a video call. The round travertine coffee table stands in front of the sofa, holding flowers and an empty tablet stand. The brass floor lamp stands beside the sofa. The brass-framed kitchen doorway on the right wall is empty. Camera side: in front of the sofa, on the TV wall side, facing the sofa and the windows.

shots.camera: Wide shot, fast push in, eye level, from the TV wall facing the sofa and the windows
shots.visual: The bright penthouse living room. Su Yaqing lounges on the cream sofa with her legs tucked up, holding the phone at arm's length and smiling at the call.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, cool and firm): {可惜，现在的纪然，已经不会再任人摆布了。}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye level, from the coffee table side facing the sofa
shots.visual: Su Yaqing's eyebrows rise and a delighted grin spreads across her face as she looks at the phone screen.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, crisp): {无论是路少泽也好，还是其他人也罢，}

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, high angle, from the TV wall side
shots.visual: Su Yaqing sits up straight on the sofa and pulls the phone closer to her face.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, decisive): {我的男人，我自己选，我要。}

shots.camera: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye level, from the coffee table side
shots.visual: Su Yaqing blinks in amused disbelief and cocks her head.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Su Yaqing, in Chinese, amused, rising): {嗯？还选老公？}

shots.camera: Medium shot, slow pull out, eye level, from the TV wall facing the sofa
shots.visual: Su Yaqing's jaw drops, and she clutches a silk cushion to her chest while staring at the phone.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, matter-of-fact): {对，我要公开招聘面试，海选。}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, handheld, low angle, from the coffee table side
shots.visual: Su Yaqing bursts out laughing, flops back against the cushions and waves her free hand at the phone.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Su Yaqing, in Chinese, laughing and teasing): {纪然，亏你想得出来啊，你当这是选秀呢，还海选。}

shots.camera: Close-up insert, tilt down following the phone, high angle, over the travertine coffee table
shots.visual: Su Yaqing's hand props the phone upright in the tablet stand on the coffee table beside the flowers.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, brisk): {相亲的话效率太慢，太浪费时间，我哪有那么多时间}

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the TV wall facing the sofa
shots.visual: Su Yaqing sits back on the sofa facing the phone on the stand, rolls her eyes playfully and nods along.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, dry with a faint amused lilt): {跟那么多男人周旋，搞个集中面试效率最高喽。}

segments.light_audio: Soft daylight through the sheer curtains behind the sofa and the brass floor lamp. Quiet penthouse with a faint city outside, and a small speaker tone on Ji Ran's voice.

dialogue.speaker: ji_ran
dialogue.line: 可惜，现在的纪然，已经不会再任人摆布了。无论是路少泽也好，还是其他人也罢，我的男人，我自己选，我要。

dialogue.speaker: ji_ran
dialogue.line: 对，我要公开招聘面试，海选。

dialogue.speaker: su_yaqing
dialogue.line: 纪然，亏你想得出来啊，你当这是选秀呢，还海选。

dialogue.speaker: ji_ran
dialogue.line: 相亲的话效率太慢，太浪费时间，我哪有那么多时间跟那么多男人周旋，搞个集中面试效率最高喽。

must_hit: Su Yaqing on the cream sofa on a phone video call
Su Yaqing laughs at the idea of an open audition
Su Yaqing props the phone on the tablet stand
segments.exit_state: Su Yaqing sits on the cream bouclé sofa in the middle of the room, its back to the curtained windows, facing the phone propped on the tablet stand on the round travertine coffee table, which also holds flowers. The brass floor lamp stands beside the sofa. The brass-framed kitchen doorway on the right wall is empty.

segments.scene_heading: INT. SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM - DAY #1-4#
segments.time: Day, soft daylight through sheer curtains
segments.first_state: Su Yaqing sits on the cream bouclé sofa in the middle of the room, its back to the curtained windows, facing the phone propped on the tablet stand on the round travertine coffee table, which also holds flowers. The brass floor lamp stands beside the sofa. The brass-framed kitchen doorway on the right wall is empty.

shots.camera: Medium shot, slow push in, low angle, from beside the coffee table facing the sofa
shots.visual: Su Yaqing sits forward on the edge of the sofa toward the phone on the stand, her eyes lighting up with an idea.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Su Yaqing, in Chinese, eager): {哎，那我弟最近刚好回国了，}

shots.camera: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye level, from the coffee table side
shots.visual: Su Yaqing gives a sly matchmaker's grin and counts the points off on her fingers beside her face.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Su Yaqing, in Chinese, coaxing and sing-song): {要不你选他，知根知底的，又听话又懂事多好。}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye level, from the TV wall side facing the sofa
shots.visual: Su Yaqing pouts at the phone on the stand.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, dry, brushing it off): {就你那个继母家的弟弟？算了算了，}

shots.camera: Medium shot, tilt up following the phone, high angle, over the travertine coffee table
shots.visual: Su Yaqing leans in and lifts the phone off the tablet stand into both hands.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, firm): {豪门联姻水太深，我就算要找，也要找个普通人。}

shots.camera: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye level, from the coffee table side
shots.visual: Su Yaqing makes a mock-sulky face at the phone screen.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Su Yaqing, in Chinese, mock-wounded): {你们苏家我可招惹不起。}

shots.camera: Medium shot, slow push in, low angle, from beside the coffee table
shots.visual: Su Yaqing's teasing smile fades. She nods slowly and settles back into the cushions with a sympathetic frown.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Su Yaqing, in Chinese, softening and gentle): {嗯也是，毕竟你父母当年闹成那样，你又被你爸当成联姻工具，}

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the TV wall facing the sofa
shots.visual: Su Yaqing looks up and smiles warmly at the phone, holding it in both hands.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Su Yaqing, in Chinese, warm and loyal): {然然，反正不管你做什么，}

shots.camera: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the TV wall facing the sofa and the kitchen doorway on the right wall
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu steps out of the kitchen into the brass-framed doorway on the right wall, holding a glass of water. Su Yaqing on the sofa keeps smiling at her phone without seeing him.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Su Yaqing, in Chinese, warm): {我都支持你。} <Soft footsteps>

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single, slow push in, low angle, from the TV wall side facing the kitchen doorway
shots.visual: Only Lin Qingyu, framed on the face and shoulders. He leans against the brass doorframe, sips from the glass and gives a quiet, knowing smile toward the sofa.

segments.light_audio: Soft daylight through the sheer curtains, the brass floor lamp, and a glow of white marble from the kitchen. Quiet room, a small speaker tone on Ji Ran's voice, soft footsteps.

dialogue.speaker: su_yaqing
dialogue.line: 哎，那我弟最近刚好回国了，要不你选他，知根知底的，又听话又懂事多好。

dialogue.speaker: ji_ran
dialogue.line: 就你那个继母家的弟弟？算了算了，豪门联姻水太深，我就算要找，也要找个普通人。

dialogue.speaker: su_yaqing
dialogue.line: 你们苏家我可招惹不起。嗯也是，毕竟你父母当年闹成那样，你又被你爸当成联姻工具，然然，反正不管你做什么，我都支持你。

must_hit: Su Yaqing eagerly pitches her brother to the phone
Su Yaqing tells Ji Ran she supports her, smiling at the phone
Lin Qingyu stands in the kitchen doorway holding a glass, listening and smiling
segments.exit_state: Su Yaqing sits on the cream bouclé sofa in the middle of the room, its back to the curtained windows, holding the phone in both hands and smiling at the call. The round travertine coffee table stands in front of her with flowers and the empty tablet stand. The brass floor lamp stands beside the sofa. Lin Qingyu leans in the brass-framed kitchen doorway on the right wall, holding the glass of water, watching her and smiling.
negative: spatial jumps of the kitchen doorway

segments.scene_heading: INT. SU YAQING'S DINING AREA - DAY #1-5#
segments.time: Day, daylight through the window on the left wall
segments.first_state: Lin Qingyu sits in the grey upholstered chair at the window end of the white marble dining table, beside the large window on the left wall. He wears the white cotton hoodie with its sleeves pushed up, the beige drawstring joggers and white sneakers. He holds the black call phone in one hand. On the table are one glass vase of white daisies and one bottle of red wine. The walnut sideboard stands against the back wall, and the open archway to the living room is on the right wall. Camera side: in front of the table, on the plant and wine cabinet side, facing the sideboard.

shots.camera: Wide shot, fast push in, eye level, from the wine cabinet facing the table and the sideboard
shots.visual: The sunlit dining area with daisies and red wine on the marble table. Lin Qingyu sits at the window end and raises the phone to his ear, and his smile fades.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lin Qingyu, in Chinese, cool and commanding): {阿杰，给我准备一套最普通的大学生衣服，}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye level, from the table's near side
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu glances toward the archway on the right wall, his expression serious, the phone at his ear.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lin Qingyu, in Chinese, low and precise): {再帮我处理一下个人资料，从明天开始，}

shots.camera: Close-up, slow push in, eye level, from the table's near side
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu's eyes narrow with quiet determination.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lin Qingyu, in Chinese, firm): {我就是一名普通的大学生。}

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, low angle, from the near side of the marble table past the daisies
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu leans forward and lays his free hand flat on the marble table beside the vase of daisies.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lin Qingyu, in Chinese, lowered and stern): {另外，这件事，绝对不能让我姐知道。}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, high angle, from the wine cabinet side
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu keeps his lips closed while he listens. His brow tightens and his fingers tap the marble once.
shots.audio: Dialogue (AJIE, V.O., in Chinese, anxious and quick through a phone speaker): {老板，您明天要出席港城的行业高峰论坛，您...}

shots.camera: Close-up, locked-off camera, low angle, from the table's near side
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu cuts in without hesitation, and a faint confident smile touches his lips.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lin Qingyu, in Chinese, cool and final): {推了，明天，我要去面试。}

segments.light_audio: Daylight through the sheer curtains of the window on the left wall falling across the table, and the brass pendant lamp. Quiet room and a thin phone speaker voice.

dialogue.speaker: lin_qingyu
dialogue.line: 阿杰，给我准备一套最普通的大学生衣服，再帮我处理一下个人资料，从明天开始，我就是一名普通的大学生。另外，这件事，绝对不能让我姐知道。

dialogue.speaker: ajie
dialogue.line: 老板，您明天要出席港城的行业高峰论坛，您...

must_hit: Lin Qingyu at the window end of the dining table on a phone call, his expression turning serious
Lin Qingyu cuts off his assistant with a confident smile
segments.exit_state: Lin Qingyu sits in the chair at the window end of the white marble dining table beside the window on the left wall, the phone at his ear and a faint confident smile on his face. The vase of daisies and the wine bottle stand on the table, and the archway to the living room is on the right wall.

Su Yaqing, heiress of the Su family
